name: AstroPinch

description: AstroPinch is India's most comprehensive free AI-powered Vedic astrology platform. It combines ancient Jyotish wisdom with modern AI technology to generate personalized birth charts (Janam Kundali), Kundali matching reports, Vimshottari Dasha predictions, KP astrology event predictions, numerology readings, Panchang calendar, and daily horoscopes — all backed by Swiss Ephemeris (NASA/JPL) astronomical data.

offers.description: Free birth chart, Kundali matching, horoscope, and AI report. No account required.

audience.audienceType: People seeking personalized Vedic astrology readings, marriage compatibility (Kundali matching), career guidance, spiritual insights, and numerology. Primarily Indian audiences and global astrology enthusiasts.

faq.question: What is AstroPinch?
faq.answer: AstroPinch is a free AI-powered Vedic astrology platform that generates personalized birth charts, Kundali matching reports, Dasha predictions, KP astrology readings, and numerology using Swiss Ephemeris for astronomical accuracy.

faq.question: Is AstroPinch free?
faq.answer: Yes, AstroPinch is completely free. No account or payment required for birth chart, Kundali matching, or horoscope.

faq.question: How accurate is AstroPinch?
faq.answer: AstroPinch uses Swiss Ephemeris (NASA/JPL) and Lahiri Ayanamsa for Vedic sidereal accuracy, calculating planetary positions, Nakshatras, Dashas, and cusps to the minute.

faq.question: What is Kundali matching?
faq.answer: Kundali matching (Gun Milan / Ashta-Koota) compares birth charts for marriage compatibility on 36 points across 8 Kootas. AstroPinch provides instant online reports with Manglik Dosha analysis.

faq.question: Does AstroPinch support Hindi?
faq.answer: Yes, AstroPinch supports English and Hindi for all reports including birth chart, horoscope, and Kundali matching.
